correction: Prevent partial or differently reviewed panels from supplying complete-panel percentage-point comparisons.
scope: Audit index presentation only; simulation, metric definitions, captured frames and frozen manifests unchanged.

method.cohortIdentity: Protocol version, metric version, frozen preset source hashes, raw seeds, histories, and ages.
method.reviewIdentity: Exact sorted set of (caseId, fromAge, toAge) for primary reviewed comparisons.
method.completeness: All expected comparisons from the manifest, with no duplicate/unexpected pairs or invalid distinctiveness scores.
method.partialPanels: Show their numerator, denominator and coverage; do not calculate pp changes or use them as complete baselines.
method.baseline: Earliest captured complete run matching both cohort and exact reviewed-pair set.
method.regenerationEffect: Reads frozen manifests and visual-review JSON; writes only INDEX.md. No frame collection, rendering, or metric reanalysis.

preservedCaptureProvenance.note: The old run.ts SHA remains in each frozen capture manifest as the code used at capture. The corrected presentation code has its own SHA above; no captured run is silently retagged.
